latest.description: The UK plans to expand the Bank of England’s remit to support digital payments innovation, including stablecoins, while keeping financial stability first.

latest.title: Best Buy tops quarterly estimates, raises outlook as computing shows strength
latest.description: Best Buy raised its full fiscal-year outlook on Thursday after reporting a stronger-than-expected first-half performance.

latest.title: Fed's Lisa Cook turns mortgage allegations back on Trump and his Cabinet
latest.description: The Supreme Court in late June blocked Trump from firing Cook from the Federal Reserve, but left the president with a path to try again to remove her.

latest.title: The Clarity Act will put Main Street banks at a disadvantage
latest.description: The Blockchain Association’s Summer Mersinger dismisses the harm to community banks in defending the stablecoin rewards language in the Clarity Act, says community banker Nate Franzén.

latest.description: Jeanie Buss, governor of the Lakers, is contesting her siblings' decision to sell the family's remaining stake in the NBA team.

latest.description: The policymaker stopped just short of calling for an interest rate hike.

latest.title: AI bug reports trigger emergency warning for Bitcoin Lightning node operators
latest.description: Developers are holding details for two weeks while fixes reach operators, in the second Lightning security emergency this month traced to AI work on Bitcoin code.

latest.title: American Airlines adds batch of new international routes on its XLR planes
latest.description: American is adding seven routes to its 2027 schedule, with the majority heading to smaller European cities from its Philadelphia hub or from New York City.

latest.description: As tech giants race to beat China in the AI infrastructure buildout, the U.S. is reportedly considering enforcing tariffs on semiconductors.

latest.title: Nvidia jumps 7% after blockbuster earnings boost AI confidence
latest.description: Nvidia shares rose on Thursday after the chip giant's revenue guidance reassured investors that AI demand will remain strong.
